name: yuri-db-lab
description: A from-scratch database systems lab with SQL parsing, slotted pages, WAL, B+Tree indexing, CLI, and benchmarks.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ydb/core && npm run build -w @ydb/cli && npm run build -w @ydb/bench && npm run build -w @ydb/workbench
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ydb/core && npm run typecheck -w @ydb/cli && npm run typecheck -w @ydb/bench && npm run typecheck -w @ydb/workbench
scripts.bench: npm run build -w @ydb/core && npm run build -w @ydb/bench && node apps/bench/dist/index.js
scripts.workbench: npm run build -w @ydb/core && npm run build -w @ydb/workbench && npm run start -w @ydb/workbench
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run audit && npm run build
